name: precip_splash
_comment: : rain-impact FOAM. atlas_layer 4 is a render-side SENTINEL the particle frag shader reads to draw this as a clean near-white foam burst (no scene-light tint, no additive glow) instead of a coloured emissive sprite. spawn_rate 0 (impact-spawned only) so it is excluded from the deterministic emitter-descriptor snapshot. Colours are a near-neutral pale white-blue so the burst reads as a small subtle whitish foam pop, never coloured speckle.
